Zero-shot transfer of knockdown effects from public CRISPRi screens: Arc VCC 2025 H1 where measured, otherwise a blend (unit directions averaged) of Replogle 2022 K562 genome-wide and the Marson lab genome-wide primary CD4+ T-cell screen. Each gene's predicted change is scaled by a transfer slope learned by shrunk per-gene regression on other cell types (Arc H1, Nadig Jurkat and HepG2); overall size 0.5. Cells are control cells with each gene's summed counts set to the prediction; the 8,000 most confident genes per knockdown are redistributed across cells in the predicted direction, using the response shared by knockdowns in public screens as a prior. Genes whose TSS lies within 1 kb (5 kb) of the target TSS are predicted down 4 (2) log2 units, modelling CRISPRi spreading to neighbouring promoters (positions from GENCODE v46). Classical statistical model, no neural network.

THE ONE CHANGE: the 400 predicted cells per perturbation are pulled toward their group mean,
`D <- m + 0.5*(D - m)`; each cell is then restored to its original library size, and entries that
were ZERO in that cell originally are set back to zero. tile=1.0 (no change) is what we always
shipped.

WHY. fid and jaccard are the only metrics on which we score NEGATIVE: fid_raw = k /
max(n_pred, N_conf), and because we add a CONSTANT per-gene shift the Wilcoxon test separates
perfectly, so n_pred is pinned at the number of shifted genes (15094) and fid degenerates to the
PRECISION of our significant call set (~0.46, below a coin flip).

Raising the shift raises k but costs more: measured online, alpha=2 moved fid -0.169 -> -0.027 and
jaccard -0.029 -> +0.001, but nmae collapsed +0.025 -> -0.385, net -0.037. alpha scales the MEAN,
and pds/nmae/mse all read the mean. `tile` does not: it changes only within-group dispersion, which
is what the DE/Wilcoxon gate reads, leaving the pseudobulk mean essentially untouched.

WHY THE ZERO-MASK: tiling alone forces every cell onto the group mean's support, raising non-zeros
per cell 16% and the merged file from 16.7 to 19.2 GB -- and `vcc prep` peaks near 35 GB against a
36 GiB cap, so it was OOM-killed twice. The mask keeps the dispersion reduction with sparsity, file
size and prep memory unchanged, and is more faithful: a cell that did not express a gene should not
acquire counts for it.

HONEST UNCERTAINTY: the direction is NOT measured -- we have never run this knob through any
evaluator, and cell-eval2 warns an under-dispersed group reads WORSE on the expression-error
members.
